+ import { anthropic } from "@ai-sdk/anthropic";
+ import { generateObject } from "ai";
+ import { z } from "zod";
+ import {
+   CompanySummaryParams,
+   CompanySummaryResult,
+   CompanyMapParams,
+   CompanyMindMap,
+ } from "../types";
+ 
+ // --- Company Summary Service ---
+ const summarySchema = z.object({
+   sections: z.array(
+     z.object({
+       heading: z.string(),
+       text: z.string(),
+     })
+   ),
+ });
+ 
+ export async function generateCompanySummary({ subpages, mainpage, websiteUrl }: CompanySummaryParams): Promise<CompanySummaryResult> {
+   const subpagesText = JSON.stringify(subpages, null, 2);
+   const mainpageText = JSON.stringify(mainpage, null, 2);
+ 
+   const { object } = await generateObject({
+     model: anthropic("claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"),
+     schema: summarySchema,
+     output: "object",
+     system:
+       "All the output content should be in simple english. Don't use any difficult words. Keep sentences short and simple.  Use unique emojis for each heading.",
+     prompt: `You are an expert at writing important points about a company.\nHere are the content from a company's website so you can understand about the company in detail.\n\nSUBPAGES CONTENT (includes about, pricing, faq, blog, etc):\n${subpagesText}\n\nMAIN WEBSITE CONTENT:\n${mainpageText}\n\nNow, after understanding about this company whose url is ${websiteUrl}, give me headings and the relevant content about it.\n\nHeadings could be the companys's: Main Product, Target Users, Pricing, Goal, Strengths, and more key points, whichever are relevant. Don't have to include a specific heading if it doesn't have enough source about it, and you can also make up your own headings whichever seems apt.\n\nDon't make up any information yourself, only use the information which is given in the above content.\n\nIt should be (an emoji with heading) and then text with it. Give maximum 6 headings (the most important ones).\n\nThe text/description should be short, simple and easy to understand.\n\nAll the output content should be in simple english.\n\nUse unique emojis for each heading.\n\nOutput the result as JSON.`,
+   });
+   return object;
+ }
+ 
+ // --- Company Mind Map Service ---
+ const mindMapNodeSchema = z.object({
+   title: z.string(),
+   children: z.array(
+     z.object({
+       title: z.string(),
+       description: z.string(),
+       children: z.array(
+         z.object({
+           title: z.string(),
+           description: z.string(),
+         })
+       ),
+     })
+   ),
+ });
+ 
+ const mindMapSchema = z.object({
+   companyName: z.string(),
+   rootNode: mindMapNodeSchema,
+ });
+ 
+ export async function generateCompanyMindMap({ mainpage, websiteUrl }: CompanyMapParams): Promise<CompanyMindMap> {
+   const mainpageText = JSON.stringify(mainpage, null, 2);
+   const { object } = await generateObject({
+     model: anthropic("claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"),
+     schema: mindMapSchema,
+     output: "object",
+     system:
+       "Create clear, concise mind maps that help users quickly understand companies. Use simple English and focus on the most important aspects.",
+     prompt: `You are an expert at creating insightful mind maps about companies.\n\nMAIN WEBSITE CONTENT:\n${mainpageText}\n\nCreate a mind map for the company at ${websiteUrl}. The mind map should:\n1. Have exactly 3 levels of depth\n2. Start with the company's main focus/product as the central node\n3. Branch into 3-4 main categories (Level 1) such as:\n   - Core Products/Services\n   - Technology/Innovation\n   - Market Position/Partnerships\n   - Company Mission/Values\n4. Each Level 1 category should have 2-3 subcategories (Level 2)\n5. Each Level 2 subcategory should have a clear description\n\nKeep all text concise and easy to understand. Focus on the most important aspects that would help someone quickly grasp what the company does and why it matters.\n\nFormat the response as a valid JSON object matching the specified schema.`,
+   });
+   return object;
+ } 
```

+ import { ResearchResponse, WebsiteResearchParams, CompetitorSearchParams, TwitterSearchParams, ExaSearchConfig } from '../types';
+ 
+ // ExaService interface for dependency injection
+ export interface ExaService {
+   search(query: string, config?: ExaSearchConfig): Promise<ResearchResponse>;
+   searchAndContents(query: string, config?: ExaSearchConfig): Promise<ResearchResponse>;
+   getContents(urls: string[], config?: ExaSearchConfig): Promise<ResearchResponse>;
+ }
+ 
+ // --- Research Service Functions ---
+ 
+ export async function fetchCrunchbaseProfile(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(`${websiteUrl} crunchbase page:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 1,
+     includeDomains: ['crunchbase.com'],
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchFinancialReport(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(`${websiteUrl} 10k financial report:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     category: 'financial report',
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     text: true,
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchFoundersLinkedin(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(`${websiteUrl} founder's Linkedin page:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 2,
+     includeDomains: ['linkedin.com'],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchFundingInfo(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(`${websiteUrl} Funding:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 1,
+     text: true,
+     summary: {
+       query: `Tell me all about the funding (and if available, the valuation) of this company in detail. Do not tell me about the company, just give all the funding information in detail. If funding or valuation info is not preset, just reply with one word "NO".`
+     },
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchGithubUrl(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(`${websiteUrl} Github:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 1,
+     includeDomains: ['github.com'],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchPitchbookProfile(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(`${websiteUrl} pitchbook profile:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 1,
+     includeDomains: ['pitchbook.com'],
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchTiktokProfile(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(`${websiteUrl} TikTok:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 1,
+     includeDomains: ['tiktok.com'],
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchTracxnProfile(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(`${websiteUrl} tracxn profile:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     numResults: 1,
+     includeDomains: ['tracxn.com'],
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchWikipediaPage(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(`${websiteUrl} company wikipedia page:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     includeDomains: ['wikipedia.org'],
+     numResults: 1,
+     text: true,
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchYoutubeVideos(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(websiteUrl, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     includeDomains: ['youtube.com'],
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+     numResults: 10,
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function findCompetitors(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl, summaryText }: CompetitorSearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(summaryText, {
+     type: 'neural',
+     useAutoprompt: true,
+     text: true,
+     summary: {
+       query: `Explain in one/two lines what does this company do in simple english. Don't use any diffcult words.`
+     },
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     excludeDomains: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function findNews(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(`${websiteUrl} Latest News:`, {
+     category: 'news',
+     type: 'keyword',
+     text: true,
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+     numResults: 10,
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function scrapeLinkedinProfile(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(`${websiteUrl} Linkedin profile:`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     text: true,
+     numResults: 1,
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function scrapeRecentTweets(exa: ExaService, { username }: TwitterSearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   const now = new Date();
+   const start = new Date(now.getTime() - 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
+   const end = new Date(now.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
+   return exa.searchAndContents(`from:${username}`, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     includeDomains: ['twitter.com'],
+     category: 'tweet',
+     startPublishedDate: start,
+     endPublishedDate: end,
+     includeText: [username],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function scrapeReddit(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.search(websiteUrl, {
+     type: 'keyword',
+     includeDomains: ['reddit.com'],
+     includeText: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function scrapeWebsiteSubPages(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.searchAndContents(websiteUrl, {
+     category: 'company',
+     type: 'neural',
+     text: true,
+     numResults: 1,
+     livecrawl: 'always',
+     subpages: 4,
+     subpageTarget: ['about', 'pricing', 'faq', 'blog'],
+     includeDomains: [websiteUrl],
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ export async function scrapeWebsiteUrl(exa: ExaService, { websiteUrl }: WebsiteResearchParams): Promise<ResearchResponse> {
+   return exa.getContents([websiteUrl], {
+     text: true,
+     summary: {
+       query: 'Describe the company in few word. It should be very simple and explicity tell what does the company do/is. Do not include the name of the company.'
+     },
+   });
+ } 
```

+ # AI Service Abstraction Layer
+ 
+ This package provides a unified, decoupled abstraction for all core AI and research logic used across the platform. It is designed to be imported by API endpoints, server actions, or other services, and is fully decoupled from any API or framework logic.
+ 
+ ## Architecture
+ - **Pure async functions** for all AI/LLM and research operations
+ - **No API/Next.js/server logic**: only business logic and data transformation
+ - **TypeScript-first**: all types are exported from `lib/types.ts`
+ - **Dependency injection** for Exa-based research (see below)
+ 
+ ## Modules
+ 
+ ### 1. Company Insights (Anthropic/LLM)
+ - `generateCompanySummary(params: CompanySummaryParams): Promise<CompanySummaryResult>`
+ - `generateCompanyMindMap(params: CompanyMapParams): Promise<CompanyMindMap>`
+ 
+ These functions use Anthropic Claude and Zod schemas to generate structured company summaries and mind maps from website content.
+ 
+ ### 2. Research (Exa)
+ All Exa-based research functions require an `ExaService` instance (dependency injection pattern):
+ 
+ ```ts
+ import { ExaService, fetchCrunchbaseProfile, fetchFinancialReport, ... } from './lib/services';
+ 
+ const exa: ExaService = ... // your Exa instance
+ const result = await fetchCrunchbaseProfile(exa, { websiteUrl: 'https://example.com' });
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Available Research Functions
+ - `fetchCrunchbaseProfile`
+ - `fetchFinancialReport`
+ - `fetchFoundersLinkedin`
+ - `fetchFundingInfo`
+ - `fetchGithubUrl`
+ - `fetchPitchbookProfile`
+ - `fetchTiktokProfile`
+ - `fetchTracxnProfile`
+ - `fetchWikipediaPage`
+ - `fetchYoutubeVideos`
+ - `findCompetitors`
+ - `findNews`
+ - `scrapeLinkedinProfile`
+ - `scrapeRecentTweets`
+ - `scrapeReddit`
+ - `scrapeWebsiteSubPages`
+ - `scrapeWebsiteUrl`
+ 
+ All functions return a `Promise<ResearchResponse>`.
+ 
+ ## Types
+ All request/response types are exported from `lib/types.ts`.
+ 
+ ## Usage Example
+ ```ts
+ import { generateCompanySummary, fetchCrunchbaseProfile, ExaService } from '@yourorg/ai';
+ 
+ // LLM-based summary
+ const summary = await generateCompanySummary({ subpages, mainpage, websiteUrl });
+ 
+ // Exa-based research
+ const exa: ExaService = ... // your Exa instance
+ const crunchbase = await fetchCrunchbaseProfile(exa, { websiteUrl: 'https://example.com' });
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Extending
+ - Add new AI/LLM or research functions as pure async functions in `lib/services/`
+ - Add new types to `lib/types.ts`
+ - Do not add any API/server logic to this package 
```
